description: This script manages downloading, cleaning, and setting environment paths for debugging tools such as lsof, gperftools, strace, and gdb. It includes functions to download or clean tools and configure environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs timestamped messages to the log file.

methods.name: clean_debug_tool
methods.description: Cleans all or specific debug tools by executing the download script with cleanup parameters.

methods.name: set_path_variable_lsof
methods.description: Sets the PATH environment variable to include lsof binary path if it exists.

methods.name: set_path_variable_gperftools
methods.description: Sets PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and PERL5LIB environment variables for gperftools if available.

methods.name: set_path_variable_strace
methods.description: Adds strace binary path to PATH environment variable.

methods.name: set_path_variable_gdb
methods.description: Adds gdb binary path to PATH environment variable.

methods.name: set_all_path_variables
methods.description: Calls all individual environment setup functions for debugging tools.
